candidates.statement: Speciﬁcally, any theory of anyons must have braiding and fusion rules that satisfy consistency conditions known as the pentagon and hexagon equations (collectively, the Seiberg-Moore Polynomial Equations.) Maclane’s coherence theorem states these are in fact all that is required in order to achieve commutativity of all combinations of fusion and braiding (i.e. a consistent physical theory).
